name: Get JSON Path
description: The value at a path inside an object or parsed JSON — 'order.items[0].sku', 'customer.address.city' — undefined when the path is not there; for reading a nested field out of a webhook payload or an API response without a code component.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= String(path ?? '').replace(/\\[(\\d+)\\]/g, '.$1').split('.').filter(Boolean).reduce((o, k) => (o == null ? undefined : o[k]), value) }}"}]
